matchups.tips: | Can never really go in if she has E. Once that's down though easy kill. Just care of her knockup.
| Pretty weak early game so you should have all the pressure. If she goes Sunfire it's annoying though and you can't win 1v1.
| Easy matchup. You one-shot him a lot quicker than he one-shots you. Crush him early game.
| You can easily match her pressure early game and win because you can dodge her cacoon with Q or block it with W. Also very squishy.

| Pre 6, easy af. Post 6, kinda annoying but still easy. In mid-late game I usually just hunt down where I think the Eve is going to be because if you get the jump on her gg. Consider getting MoM late game if she is fed.
| Very close to being as aids as Karthus. Insane clear, we don't do enough damage to trouble him, he can heal off our W. And his W still works when we Q.

| Because Gragas players now go AP it's a lot easier of a matchup. His abilities are easy to dodge, can block his E with our W, R his R...sometimes hard to kill because of passive, but one of the most playable.

| One of the worst matchups for Shaco. Any champ with a dash is hard to 1v1, makes it even harder with emberknife (red smite), his W gives him time to reposition/damage, can one-shot us with a proper combo.

| His kit just does well against our playstyle. Hecarim has good clear speed, good 1v1, and can impact the map as well as anyone. They can outgank and outfarm you. You can Q and R his E and R. Pressure early (before his first base) otherwise lock in Udyr or someone.

| All about the first couple of levels. Make sure team protects Level 1. After that he's easy to play against 1v1, but he makes his carries very hard to kill. Focus him in fights to weaken his teammates.
| I don't think I've ever died to a J4. You can dodge everything, and they normally aren't too tanky so you can easily kill.
| Blue Kayn: easy. Crush him early game.

| Clears 10x quicker, doesn't matter if you kill him. You can jump on him but you're so squishy until 6th item you probably just trade 1 for 1. Possible ban. Note: you can R his R and use stopwatch too, but you don't want to be using your R to evade a Requiem.

| Easy enough matchup but Riot's love affair with this champ makes him somewhat annoying as well. Instant invisibility cucks us and he might be able to turn it around with his ridiculous isolation damage. Very weak early so stamp on the cockroach.

| A good Kindred is up there with the worst of them. Ward second buff and care of Level 1 cheese. If you get the jump on her from fog that's great (especially before Level 6), but it's a lot easier said than done. Her R really cucks us.
| Pretty hard. You can never really 1v1 him unless you are turbo fed. Note: you can box his Q, Deceive his Q, even R his R if you time it right.
| Will probably always full clear so charge at her! She can become more annoying though with Liandry/Demonic tick damage (kinda like Karthus) so be a bit care when going in mid-late game.
| Pressure early. We can stop his W with our W and he does no damage until 2-3 items deep. We can also R his Q if you time it right. Red smite Yi is a bit of a cuck though.

| Play against a Challenger Nidalee. Won't be an issue in lower elos, but more skilled Nidalees are impossible to play against. Good ones will always make sure to keep their distance and poke us down, and when behind it is very hard to have an impact on the game. Possible ban.
| Can be annoying. You can't dodge his E (fear), and Nocturnes usually Red Smite so they're hard to duel.
| Should never be able to kill us but you can't do anything against him. I personally dislike playing against them. Obnoxious champion and playstyle.
| His Q kills our boxes, and he's a strong dueler at every stage of the game while being tanky. Can definitely invade him early if he's AFK full-clearing. Need Ignite to win 1v1.
| Won't do anything to you, but you can't do anything to him. Not as annoying as Nunu but if his lanes win it's still over.
| Rengar wins most 1v1's I feel. And his R will reveal our invis. Also early game he can invade/late invade us Level 1 and we can't do anything. I don't like.
| Her passive makes it hard to do anything and we can never really go in until she comes out of her burrow form. I think there are worse matchups though so I don't ban.
| Similar to Rammus. Just a bit meh.
| Shacorruption.
| Both AD and AP Shyvanna do well 1v1ing Shaco - her W can kill our box and she's hard to kill. Dodge her E and focus on fighting her early - don't let her free farm camps.
| Haven't played against many Skarners but his head alone makes it tough. I don't think there's much to worry about though. Just don't headbutt him when he's 6.
| If she stays at range, yes...she is annoying. But she has no escape if you get on her (unlike Nidalee). Also nowhere near as strong early game (long cooldowns).
| Will be really low from clearing early game so be aggressive. Should never die to him either because you can dodge everything.
| Can Q our box, strong dueler. Only jump in if you can execute him. Need Ignite to 1v1.
| R sees you.
| Braindead aids playstyle that is just unfun to play against. Even if you are 5-0 at 5 minutes he has 50 cs and can still 1v1 you.
| Weak early and we can dodge her R with ours and Q out of the way of her Q.
| Has good DPS and with red smite is hard to 1v1. Pressure early - he has long cooldowns.
| Pretty annoying champion because you can't really kill him without ignite. Thankfully he can't clear at Udyr-speed.
| Not that fun for AD Shaco but it's not too bad. Just watch out for his E...once that's down you can possibly kill.
| Lee Sin, Wukong, Xin Zhao...all the same.
| Pretty much Lee Sin but not blind.
| Same as Rammus and Sej. If his lanes win even if you get a kill in each of them, impossible game to play.
| Can dodge all of his stuff, and his early game is terrible.
| Just turn screen on and dodge her spells.
| She jumps in that's good just be ready.
